data.long_meaning: The name Karunya is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘karuna’ which means compassion, mercy, and kindness. This name is often given to girls in Hindu culture to symbolize the qualities of warmth, tenderness, and understanding. The name Karunya carries the meaning “Compassion, Mercy” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Karunya usually hope their child will grow to embody compassion, mercy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
